description: EXP-003 [P1 fine-tuning recipe]: P1's two-phase transfer learning with Adam [A] - phase 1 frozen backbone, head lr 1e-3; phase 2 unfreeze the last blocks, single lr 1e-5 for every trainable parameter, no third full-unfreeze phase. Total 30 epochs (5 + 25) to match EXP-001's compute. Preprocessing (CLAHE on) and augmentation identical to EXP-001. Adam instead of AdamW follows the paper; weight_decay 0 because P1 reports none.
